legacy_root.answer: The written 15-value procedure maps each fully extracted candidate to exactly one vocabulary value via a total tie-break order ['UNKNOWN-NEEDS-PROBE', 'REJECT', 'RETIRE', 'TRANSLATE', 'CLEAN-ROOM-REIMPLEMENT', 'REBUILD-FROM-SPEC', 'COMPOSE', 'MERGE', 'GENERALIZE', 'SPECIALIZE', 'EXTEND', 'REPAIR', 'DISTILL', 'ADOPT-WITH-WRAPPER', 'ADOPT-AS-IS']. On the frozen 20-record gold set (version 1) author and independent replay both match gold labels 20/20; per-disposition agreement meets floor 1.0 for every value (no aggregate-only pass). GOLD-09 with license=EMPTY refuses to UNKNOWN-NEEDS-PROBE (missing_input=license); restoring license yields ADOPT-AS-IS. Overlap REJECT+RETIRE resolves to REJECT. WFA-0042/WFA-0043/WFA-0005 artifacts are absent on this tree; the 15-value list is taken from the catalog/spec (WFA-0005) and is not deleted for zero corpus count. SUCCESS:WFA-0068

criteria.criterion: A required extraction input is present, but a named settling probe is still required (probe_needed=true). Missing required inputs are handled by the refusal path before this rule.
criteria.falsifier: A complete record with probe_needed=false must not take this rule.
A fit, non-hostile record must not REJECT.
An active, present source must not RETIRE.

criteria.criterion: runtime is a foreign orchestration plane (not the chosen control plane).
criteria.falsifier: A claude-code/claude-workflows runtime must not TRANSLATE.

criteria.criterion: license in {UNLICENSED, INCOMPATIBLE, UNKNOWN} AND reimplementable.
criteria.falsifier: A permissive licensed record must not CLEAN-ROOM-REIMPLEMENT.
A usable source, or an unusable source with no spec, must not REBUILD-FROM-SPEC.

criteria.criterion: compose_of names at least two existing candidate ids.
criteria.falsifier: A singleton or empty compose_of must not COMPOSE.

criteria.criterion: duplicate_of is a non-empty candidate id.
criteria.falsifier: A record with no duplicate_of must not MERGE.
A record that is not too-narrow must not GENERALIZE.
A record that is not too-broad must not SPECIALIZE.
A record with defects or no gaps must not EXTEND.
A defect-free or unsalvageable record must not REPAIR.
A take-whole adoption must not DISTILL.

criteria.criterion: needs_wrapper AND runtime is not a foreign orchestration plane.
criteria.falsifier: needs_wrapper=false must not ADOPT-WITH-WRAPPER.

criteria.criterion: control-plane runtime, smoke_passes, permissive license, no wrapper, no defects, no gaps, take_whole is not false.
criteria.falsifier: A failing smoke case or foreign runtime must not ADOPT-AS-IS.

gold_set.sampling_rule: Before selection: cover all 9 families A-I; cover all 15 dispositions; include exactly one deliberate missing-required-input record; freeze version=1; later edits require a version bump.
gold_set.source: constructed-for-WFA-0068; WFA-0042 extraction gold artifact absent on this tree

independent_replay.why_not_cross_vendor_llm: This substrate does not invoke a second vendor model. Mechanical independence is a second code path over the same written criteria that never reads gold labels.

refusal_path.when: any required input is None/empty/EMPTY, or extraction_complete is not true
